This is the published decode-uri-component 0.5.0 implementation from https://registry.npmjs.org/decode-uri-component/-/decode-uri-component-0.5.0.tgz, with only its export changed to CommonJS for Expo Router 55 and query-string 7.

The unmodified upstream MIT license and its public author attribution are retained in LICENSE; this attribution is intentional third-party licensing metadata.

Version 0.5.0 replaces recursive malformed UTF-8 decoding with a linear scan to fix GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr, without changing the callable API expected by the installed router.
